description: Default web search tool. SearXNG metasearch across engines with time_range, categories, engine selection and result scoring. Not for news-only lookups (news_search) or full-page content retrieval (web_fetch/scrapling).

searxng_web_search.name: web_search
searxng_web_search.description: Perform a web search across multiple engines; returns titles, URLs and summaries. Supports time_range (day/week/month/year), language, safesearch, num_results, categories and engines filters. Default starting point for general research.
